verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents a beta Agent Management API that can create, discover, update and delete agents, manage agent files and skills, and authenticate machine clients. A probe also found an OpenAPI spec on the docs site. This covers only agent management, not parity with the whole UI. The MCP evidence describes LibreChat consuming MCP servers, not exposing its own features, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of conversations/chat, memory, scheduled chats, search, admin/config and settings; an explicit parity claim; non-beta status; hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Agent Management API (beta): Create, discover, update, and delete Agents; manage Agent files and Skills; and authenticate machine clients through deployment-bound OIDC identities
